name: TypeScript
description: Work with strict types, public interfaces and builds.
guidance: For TypeScript work, inspect the nearest tsconfig and project references. Preserve strictness and exported contracts. Reuse existing types and narrow unknown input at boundaries. Run the repository's typecheck after changing a public type.

name: React
description: Improve component state, data flow and interactions.
guidance: For React work, locate the state owner and keep derived values out of effect-driven state. Use effects for external synchronization and clean them up. Preserve keyboard paths and controlled inputs. Verify behavior through the rendered component.

name: Next.js
description: Build routes, server and client boundaries, and data cache behavior.
guidance: For Next.js work, identify App Router or Pages Router and existing runtime. Keep server-only code and credentials out of client modules. Check caching and revalidation at the route or data boundary. Validate the affected URL on the supported runtime.

name: Vue
description: Work with reactive state, composables and templates.
guidance: For Vue work, follow the repository's Options API or Composition API conventions. Use computed properties for derived state and clean up watchers that touch external systems. Verify emits, props, slot behavior and keyboard interaction through the affected view.

name: Svelte
description: Maintain reactive components and SvelteKit routes.
guidance: For Svelte work, identify the major version and whether the component uses runes or legacy reactivity. Keep browser-only code out of server render paths. Preserve form behavior without JavaScript where the route already supports it. Verify entity updates and navigation.

name: Angular
description: Work with templates, services, signals and forms.
guidance: For Angular work, follow existing standalone or module conventions. Keep subscriptions bounded to the relevant lifecycle. Verify template bindings, form validity and dependency scopes through the configured test or build entry point.

name: Python
description: Use the project's runtime, environments and tests.
guidance: For Python work, inspect pyproject.toml and the repository's virtual environment and package runner. Avoid editing lockfiles by hand. Preserve supported interpreter versions. Run the relevant package tests from the documented environment, and use fixtures for IO.

name: .NET
description: Work across SDK versions, project boundaries and async code.
guidance: For .NET work, read the target frameworks, SDK pins and solution boundaries. Propagate cancellation and use asynchronous APIs for IO. Dispose owned resources and preserve nullable contracts. Verify the exact project and configuration affected.

name: Rust
description: Maintain Cargo features, ownership and error handling.
guidance: For Rust work, check Cargo workspace members, features and the minimum supported Rust version. Prefer explicit errors and scoped borrows to unnecessary cloning or panics. Run cargo checks or tests with the same feature set as the affected build.

name: Go
description: Maintain modules, error handling and goroutine lifecycles.
guidance: For Go work, use the current module and build tags. Propagate context across call boundaries, stop timers and goroutines with their owners, and handle errors with useful context. Run package-scoped go tests and use the race detector where shared state changes.

name: Git
description: Inspect history and prepare focused version-control changes.
guidance: For Git tasks, inspect repository status, branch, remotes and the targeted history. Preserve unrelated local changes. Use the smallest diff that addresses the requested change, check diff whitespace and treat destructive history operations as separate decisions.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Review query plans, indexing and schema changes.
guidance: For PostgreSQL work, verify the actual schema and query workload. Parameterize values, compare representative plans when available, and account for lock duration and transactions in migrations. Use read-only checks unless a database change is authorized.

name: SQLite
description: Handle local databases, transactions and migration safety.
guidance: For SQLite work, check schema version, foreign-key behavior and connection ownership. Use parameters and atomic transactions for coordinated writes. Test migrations against existing data and model busy or locked states where concurrent access is expected.

name: Docker
description: Review container images, Compose and local builds.
guidance: For Docker work, follow the repository's image and Compose setup. Limit the build context, keep credentials out of image layers, and check port mappings and volumes. Verify container startup and health with the correct runtime configuration.

name: Terraform
description: Review infrastructure plans, variables and dependencies.
guidance: For Terraform work, inspect states, providers, versions and environments without disclosing values. Format and validate the touched module. Review the plan for replacements and scope changes before any independently authorized apply.

name: Testing
description: Choose focused regression checks and reliable fixtures.
guidance: For testing tasks, begin at the behavior's normal entry point and reproduce the requested regression with a deterministic fixture. Assert user-visible results and important failure paths. Run the smallest useful test set first and report which runtime evidence is available.

name: Accessibility
description: Review keyboard, focus, semantics and readable controls.
guidance: For accessibility work, check control roles and names, focus order, keyboard operation, motion preferences and contrast. Preserve equivalent input access for custom interactions. Validate through the actual interface as well as source inspection.

name: Localization
description: Review translations, text growth and bidirectional layout.
guidance: For localization work, reuse message IDs and formatting utilities. Preserve placeholders and pluralization, avoid building translated sentences from fragments, and test text expansion and right-to-left layout with the interface's real locale controls.

name: Documentation
description: Write setup steps and examples from verified entry points.
guidance: For documentation, identify the audience and normal entry point. Preserve the author's terminology. Use currently verified commands and examples with safe placeholders, and distinguish successful checks from behavior that has not been verified.

name: Data analysis
description: Check data quality, metrics and reproducibility.
guidance: For data work, establish row grain, units, coverage and time zones. Check duplicate keys, nulls and outliers before calculating. State the denominator and assumptions, and reproducibly spot-check key results without dumping private rows.

name: Performance
description: Measure slow paths and verify the impact of changes.
guidance: For performance work, reproduce the slow workload and measure its baseline. Find the dominant cost before changing it, favor bounded work and reuse, and compare equivalent runtime measurements. Call out data or hardware limits that affect interpretation.
